description:
Job Title: HCM Analytics & BI Developer 
 
Job Category: Information Technology 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: None 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% 
 
Type of Travel: Continental US 
 
* * * 
 
 
 
 The Opportunity: 
 Join CACI as a Principal Consultant (HCM Analytics & BI Developer) and play a pivotal role in one of the largest federal Human Capital Management modernization initiatives in the country. This enterprise-wide program will implement Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM as the unified workforce platform supporting civilian employees across multiple federal agencies.
 In this high-impact role, you will architect and deliver the analytics ecosystem that informs federal HR leaders, agency executives, and government decision-makers. You will build real-time workforce dashboards, compliance reporting solutions, predictive analytics models, and enterprise data visualizations that shape human capital strategies across the federal landscape.
 You will work independently on complex technical and functional assignments, drive reporting innovations, and serve as a trusted expert within the program. This role offers long-term project stability, exceptional technical breadth, and the chance to make a measurable difference in government workforce modernization.
 
 This position is primarily remote; however, candidates may be required to report onsite in Reston as business needs arise. 

 
 Responsibilities: 
 Design and develop Oracle OTBI dashboards delivering real-time workforce metrics including headcount, hiring pipelines, turnover trends, vacancy rates, and demographic insights across multiple federal agencies

 Build Oracle BI Publisher (BIP) reports and templates for structured submissions such as EHRI , GHRR , SF-113 , and agency-driven HR compliance requirements

 Create advanced Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) dashboards with predictive modeling, trend analysis, and executive-level insights across agencies

 Configure and optimize HCM Extract processes for bulk data extraction and downstream analytics workflows

 Develop interactive org chart visualizations and workforce exploration tools enabling HR specialists and managers to easily navigate federal organizational hierarchies

 Deliver ad hoc reporting capabilities and self-service analytics for agency HR teams

 Build reporting solutions supporting government-wide mandates such as EEO/MD-715 , FEVS analytics , DEIA reporting , and human capital accountability standards

 Ensure all analytics outputs meet Section 508 / WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility requirements

 Develop semantic layers and governed data models that ensure consistent definitions of workforce metrics and KPIs

 Translate human capital analytics requirements into detailed technical specifications, wireframes, and reporting architecture

 Support agency onboarding by developing agency-specific reporting templates, migrating historical data, and delivering analytics training

 Operate with significant independence, solving complex technical challenges and mentoring junior team members

 Lead small technical workstreams, conduct deliverable reviews, and guide best practices across Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM

 
 
 Qualifications: 

 Required:  
 Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance (U.S. Citizenship required) 

 Bachelor’s degree and 7 years of relevant experience (additional experience may substitute for degree)

 7+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, or enterprise reporting

 5+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle OTBI , Oracle BI Publisher , or similar enterprise BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, SAP BO)

 Strong SQL proficiency with experience writing analytical queries against large-scale HR/HCM datasets

 Experience building interactive dashboards with drill-downs, parameters, and dynamic visualizations

 Knowledge of core HR/workforce analytics topics such as headcount, attrition, time-to-fill, workforce planning, and span of control

 Experience developing accessible analytics meeting Section 508 / WCAG standards

 Familiarity with Agile/SAFe development practices

 
 Desired: 
 8+ years of BI development, ideally with Oracle Fusion HCM

 Certifications in Oracle Analytics Cloud or BI Publisher 

 Experience with federal HR analytics, including EHRI, GHRR, or federal accountability reporting

 Deep understanding of Oracle Fusion HCM subject areas and data models

 Experience with predictive analytics tools such as R , Python , or OAC machine learning

 Knowledge of federal human capital frameworks, FEVS analytics, and DEIA workforce reporting

 Experience developing HCM Extract solutions for enterprise data warehousing

 Familiarity with Oracle Cloud technologies like OIC or OCI within HCM/ERP environments

 
 
 
This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI. 
 

 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$90,300-$189,600 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
